subject: Going by the rumor mill...
author: SUFFUR
body:
Cavalry Bootlegger - General Lee, Dukes of Hazard, Manhattan Spirit - Ecto 1, Ghost Busters, GT NightHawk - Kitt, Knight Rider. I could be so wrong mind, I was just looking at the rumor mill, Black Pepper... anyone?

What they will do, could be interestin' though Kitt giving me directions in a sarcastic way could be funny, 'No Michael, Your other Left', lol. A bit of  'Yeah Harrrr' from the  the Bootlegger when you do a jump, the 'Weewah' and that green ghost popping up ( I forgot his name sorry) as you drive the Spirit, or maybe it's a ghost car! And can Drive through Traffic. I assume they each have a special ability, to do something, and have sound effects to match, looking forward to seeing them in action next year.

Also the Fall Guy Pickup truck could be cool, if we are doing flash backs, lol. Or Automan's car that does 90 degree turns, and changes all the traffic and travels at 'Ludicrus Speed', lol. 

I wonder if they do that with the Bikes, Street Hawk anyone, with the back flip, lol.

Nice one Criterion, for bring some fun and laughs into the game, and with the Party Pack too, what will those other packs contain, and how will they react with the Island, and be used in game play?

Next year looks like some fun times for Paradisers.

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?
